req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all Player objects. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying exact status code, content-type, array length (26 rows), and spot-checking known player fields; (2) a negative NEG test verifying the endpoint rejects an unsupported HTTP method (POST with wrong content triggers 422, DELETE returns 405); (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the exact count of 26 players (boundary: not 25, not 27) and that every object contains all required PlayerResponseModel fields; (4) a DT test verifying cache behaviour — first call is MISS, second is HIT, both return identical data; (5) a STC test verifying the array is non-empty and each element has the exact set of camelCase keys matching PlayerResponseModel. Together these cover status-code mutations, off-by-one count mutations, field-name mutations, boolean cache-header mutations, and method-routing mutations.

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_with_full_array():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers['content-type']
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26
    keys = {'id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'}
    for player in data:
        for k in keys:
            assert k in player, f'Missing key {k} in {player}'
    messi = next((p for p in data if p['squadNumber'] == 10), None)
    assert messi is not None
    assert messi['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert messi['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert messi['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert messi['league'] == 'Ligue 1'

test_get_all_players_returns_200_with_full_array()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_exact_count_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 26
    assert len(data) != 25
    assert len(data) != 27
    squad_numbers = {p['squadNumber'] for p in data}
    assert squad_numbers == set(range(1, 27))
    assert 1 in squad_numbers
    assert 26 in squad_numbers
    assert 27 not in squad_numbers
    assert 0 not in squad_numbers

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
import asyncio

def test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('x-cache') == 'MISS'
    data1 = r1.json()
    assert len(data1) == 26
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('x-cache') == 'HIT'
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert len(data2) == 26
    ids1 = {p['id'] for p in data1}
    ids2 = {p['id'] for p in data2}
    assert ids1 == ids2

test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import re

def test_get_all_players_response_schema_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 26
    required_keys = {'id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'}
    optional_keys = {'middleName', 'dateOfBirth', 'abbrPosition', 'team', 'league', 'starting11'}
    all_keys = required_keys | optional_keys
    uuid_re = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    for p in data:
        for k in required_keys:
            assert k in p
        for k in p.keys():
            assert k in all_keys, f'Unexpected key {k}'
        assert uuid_re.match(p['id']), f'Bad UUID: {p["id"]}'
        assert isinstance(p['squadNumber'], int)
    armani = next(p for p in data if p['squadNumber'] == 1)
    assert armani['id'] == '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    assert armani['firstName'] == 'Franco'
    assert armani['lastName'] == 'Armani'
    assert armani['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'
    assert armani['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert armani['starting11'] == False

test_get_all_players_response_schema_fields()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_spot_check_multiple_known_rows():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    by_squad = {p['squadNumber']: p for p in data}
    alvarez = by_squad[9]
    assert alvarez['firstName'] == 'Julián'
    assert alvarez['lastName'] == 'Álvarez'
    assert alvarez['position'] == 'Centre-Forward'
    assert alvarez['abbrPosition'] == 'CF'
    assert alvarez['starting11'] == True
    enzo = by_squad[24]
    assert enzo['firstName'] == 'Enzo'
    assert enzo['lastName'] == 'Fernández'
    assert enzo['league'] == 'Liga Portugal'
    assert enzo['starting11'] == True
    dibu = by_squad[23]
    assert dibu['team'] == 'Aston Villa FC'
    assert dibu['starting11'] == True
    molina = by_squad[26]
    assert molina['abbrPosition'] == 'RB'
    assert molina['starting11'] == True
    assert molina['team'] == 'Atlético Madrid'

test_get_all_players_spot_check_multiple_known_rows()
